item.title: Parts and Suppliers
item.description:
Possible parts and suppliers for the HUB75 LED matrix display project, including the DIN rail, recessed handle, case latch and power cable.

TinyTronics order list

Current working order list for the HUB75 power-distribution prototype and controller service connection.

Qty Part Purpose
1 Experiment PCB 4 × 6 cm, double-sided Mechanical carrier for the first power-distribution prototype
2 Barrier Strip Screw Terminal, 4p, 7.62 mm Two 4-pole HUB75 power-distribution rails
1 Terminal Block for Removable Screw Terminal, 90°, 2p, 5.08 mm PCB-side connector for the removable 20 A main 5 V input
1 Removable Screw Terminal, 2p, 5.08 mm Cable-side plug for the removable 20 A main 5 V input
1 2 Pin Screw Terminal Block Connector, 5.08 mm Additional 10 A PCB / auxiliary 5 V connection
1 Micro USB – USB-B Extension Cable with Mount, 50 cm Bring the internal controller USB connection to an externally accessible panel-mount USB-B socket
1 Black Push Button 16 mm - Reset Candidate momentary service/reset button for the enclosure

The power-distribution items above correspond to the current power-distribution prototype concept.

item.title: Okoumé Wood Suppliers
item.description:
This page contains suppliers of Okoumé plywood for the HUB75 LED matrix display project.

Prices were checked in July 2026 and may change over time.

This first overview focuses mainly on quarter-size sheets of approximately 61 × 125 cm.

A separate overview of full-size sheets may be added later, including suppliers that can cut the material to size.

Surface types

Unprimed

Natural wood surface without primer or foil.

Primed

Factory-applied primer intended as a base for paint.
